title: Angband3D — Official Gameplay Commercial & Veteran Showcase

subtitles.speaker: Enceladus
subtitles.text: For thirty years, you mapped the pits of Morgoth through strings of green text on an eighty-column screen.

subtitles.speaker: Enceladus
subtitles.text: You memorized every glyph, every stat, and every cruel, unforgiving demise.

subtitles.speaker: Enceladus
subtitles.text: Welcome back to Angband... but open your eyes.

subtitles.speaker: Armourer
subtitles.text: Ah, another brave fool seeking glory below! Mind your torches, stranger!

subtitles.speaker: Enceladus
subtitles.text: Rule number one for the veteran: looking around will not get you killed.

subtitles.speaker: Enceladus
subtitles.text: Camera yaw costs precisely zero turns.

subtitles.speaker: Enceladus
subtitles.text: Pan the darkness, inspect every shadow, check the ceiling for spiders—the world moves only when you take a step.

subtitles.speaker: SFX
subtitles.text: [Shield Block • Steel Clang • Spider Defeated]

subtitles.speaker: Enceladus
subtitles.text: Miss your glyphs? Fear losing your classic overview? Press Tab.

subtitles.speaker: Enceladus
subtitles.text: Instantaneous, bit-for-bit Angband 4.2.6 terminal mode.

subtitles.speaker: Enceladus
subtitles.text: Same menus, same inventory hotkeys, zero compromise.

subtitles.speaker: Enceladus
subtitles.text: The 3D world and the ASCII matrix are one and the same.

subtitles.speaker: Enceladus
subtitles.text: In 3D, corridors are narrow and corners are blind. But you have ears.

subtitles.speaker: Enceladus
subtitles.text: 3D spatial audio lets you hear snoring orcs and skittering vermin around the bend before you walk into their line of sight.

subtitles.speaker: Snerk the Snaga
subtitles.text: Hssst... quiet in the dark... the man-thing smells of iron and lamp oil...

subtitles.speaker: SFX
subtitles.text: [Infravision Activated • Misty Red Silhouette Revealed]

subtitles.speaker: Enceladus
subtitles.text: Every item, every spell, every resistance from the 4.2.6 compendium is here.

subtitles.speaker: Dragon
subtitles.text: Who dares disturb the hoard of the deep?!

subtitles.speaker: SFX
subtitles.text: [Phase Door Teleport • Lightning Blast]

subtitles.speaker: Enceladus
subtitles.text: No cooldowns, no action-game shortcuts. Turn-based tactical roguelike survival.

subtitles.speaker: Enceladus
subtitles.text: Every step of your pilgrimage is penned in real time into the Living Chronicle—voiced as an epic saga.

subtitles.speaker: Enceladus
subtitles.text: Preserving your glorious victories and your most humiliating blunders for eternity.

subtitles.speaker: Enceladus
subtitles.text: Play instantly in your browser, or take it offline with standalone Windows and Android clients.

subtitles.speaker: Enceladus
subtitles.text: Your save files are universal. Angband 3D awaits. Descend if you dare.
